correctness.scope: Prepared values, error types/messages, warnings, logging, and guarded fallback behavior. Targeted finite fixtures do not prove arbitrary monkeypatched-tokenizer equivalence.

guard_findings_fixed: Reject modified class __getattr__, __getattribute__, conversion and vocabulary lookup methods.
Reject special-token properties shadowed on the instance or class hierarchy.
Require the current recognized-special-token list to contain mask_token, cls_token and sep_token.
mutation_coverage: Unset, unknown, changed, empty, newly added and AddedToken special values.
Nonstandard map/value types, missing definitions, subclasses and overridden converters.
Instance/class special-token shadows, altered recognized-token list, attribute dispatch overrides.
Ordinary and special-token-bearing text, empty requests and invalid questions.
Verbose unset-token logging and custom converter logs/exceptions.
